name: Panda
source:
"Fuzziness bestowed upon the most ill fitting creature it could be, the panda is far from docile." - In-game description

Panda is a monster encountered around mid-way through the dungeon. Upon seeing her, [url=/c48306]Ceri[/url] is incredibly enamored by her cuteness, to the point where she later personally recruits her into the party; fortunately, she is rather easily won over with the promise of all the bamboo she can eat. [url=/c48304]Yomi[/url] notes that Ceri's attempt to persuade Panda to join their side has left her the most nervous she's ever seen her.

If the player chooses to walk around the Bamboo Forest outside of town, Yomi and the party will encounter a Panda who has been robbing unfortunate travelers. Upon her defeat, plant fibers are obtained to create a new outfit for Ceri.
